Asha (CS): Quick ask — planning a 2-week enablement sprint for a mid-market tenant. Need a tiny customer-facing runbook that covers: onboarding status checks, renewal-risk signals to watch, and practical caching/batching/streaming advice customers can apply. Prefer one-pager they can follow during launch.
Jonah (Eng): +1. keep it prescriptive: health checks (avg latency, 95th, error rate), warm pools, and a prefilling checklist for KV/prefix cache.
Priya (PM): can we include a simple feedback capture step? like a 1-click NPS + 3 prompts that map to quality/cost/latency. helps triage renewal risk early.
Leo (SRE): For ops side: add quick commands and thresholds. e.g. `curl /health` -> check `latency_p50`, `latency_p95`, `error_rate`. add circuit-breaker guidance: if error_rate > 1% for 10m -> fallback flow.
Jonah (Eng): mini code snippet for client-side batching suggestion: ```python
# pseudo batching: aggregate user msgs up to 256 tokens or 50ms
buffer = []
def send_batch(msg):
    buffer.append(msg)
    if tokens(buffer) > 256 or time_since_first(buffer) > 0.05:
        post_batch(buffer)
        buffer.clear()
```
Priya (PM): Customer-facing steps (short): 1) Preflight: run the quick checks (latency/error), 2) Prefill: upload top 50 prompts to cache (or call /prefetch endpoint), 3) Streaming toggle: enable streaming for UI-first flows, 4) Cost guard: enable per-route quotas. keep wording non-technical for customers.
Asha (CS): love that. add a renewal-risk rubric: green/yellow/red based on usage trends + satisfaction survey. Example: Red if usage down >40% week-over-week AND NPS <= 4 OR repeated latency >500ms.
Leo (SRE): Add SLO-safe fallback: map routes to lower-cost model variants with config snippet: `fallback: model: small-v1 max_tokens: 256` and recommend canary % = 5% for 24h. Also note telemetry tag `prefill:true` for traces.
Jonah (Eng): quick troubleshooting bullets for customers: - If streaming stalls: check `client_timeout` vs `server_chunk_timeout`. - If warm pool not filling: verify `prefill` calls and check key eviction in cache.
Priya (PM): Feedback capture micro-form: URL to host short survey + sample questions: "Did the responses match expectations? (yes/no)", "Was latency acceptable? (0-5)", "Any critical failures? (open)". Add a webhook to route answers to CS slack channel.
deploy-bot: Published runbook draft -> https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/mini-sprint-runbooks/tenant-engage-sprint-grok-notes (permission: team-cs).
Asha (CS): Action items: 1) Jonah - convert snippets into a 1-page PDF (by EOD). 2) Priya - wire survey webhook to #customer-success and add to onboarding email (tomorrow). 3) Leo - add fallback example to runbook and confirm telemetry tag naming (48h). I'll schedule a 30m sync after docs are in. :thumbsup:
